units.locator: Article 19.24. Failure to comply with administrative restrictions and to fulfil duties imposed under administrative supervision
units.text: 1. Failure by a person placed under administrative supervision to comply with an administrative restriction or restrictions imposed on them by a court under federal law, if these actions (inaction) do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 19.24

units.locator: Article 19.24. Failure to comply with administrative restrictions and to fulfil duties imposed under administrative supervision
units.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand to one thousand five hundred roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 19.24 · “entails the imposition of an administrative fine of one…”

units.locator: Article 19.24. Failure to comply with administrative restrictions and to fulfil duties imposed under administrative supervision
units.text: 2. Failure by a person placed under administrative supervision to fulfil duties provided for by federal law, if these actions (inaction) do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 19.24

units.locator: Article 19.24. Failure to comply with administrative restrictions and to fulfil duties imposed under administrative supervision
units.text: entails a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 19.24 · “entails a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine…”

units.locator: Article 19.24. Failure to comply with administrative restrictions and to fulfil duties imposed under administrative supervision
units.text: 3. Repeated commission within one year of the administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article, if these actions (inaction) do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 19.24

units.locator: Article 19.24. Failure to comply with administrative restrictions and to fulfil duties imposed under administrative supervision
units.text: entails compulsory work for up to forty hours or administrative arrest for ten to fifteen days, or the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles on persons to whom compulsory work or administrative arrest may not be applied under this Code.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 19.24 · “entails compulsory work for up to forty hours or administrative…”

units.text: entails a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of fifteen thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles; on officials, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred and fifty thousand to four hundred thousand roubles.

units.label: Part 2 Art. 19.26

units.locator: Article 19.27. Provision of false information in the course of migration registration
units.text: 1. Provision by a foreign citizen or stateless person of knowingly false information or forged documents in the course of migration registration, if these actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 19.27

units.locator: Article 19.27. Provision of false information in the course of migration registration
units.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand to five thousand roubles, with or without administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 19.27 · “entails the imposition of an administrative fine of two…”

units.locator: Article 19.27. Provision of false information in the course of migration registration
units.text: 2. Provision by the receiving party of knowingly false information about a foreign citizen or stateless person or forged documents in the course of migration registration, except in the cases provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 19.23 of this Code, if these actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 19.27

units.locator: Article 19.27. Provision of false information in the course of migration registration
units.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, thirty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred and fifty thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 19.27 · “entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of…”

units.locator: Article 19.27. Provision of false information in the course of migration registration
units.text: 3. The violation provided for by part 1 of this Article, committed in the federal city of Moscow or St Petersburg, or in Moscow Oblast or Leningrad Oblast —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 19.27

units.locator: Article 19.27. Provision of false information in the course of migration registration
units.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of five thousand to seven thousand roubles, with or without administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 19.27 · “entails the imposition of an administrative fine of five…”

units.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity
units.text: 1. Unlawful transfer, offer or promise, on behalf of or in the interests of a legal entity or in the interests of a legal entity associated with it, of money, securities or other property to an official, a person performing managerial functions in a commercial or other organisation, a foreign official or an official of a public international organisation, the provision to them of services of a property nature or the granting to them of property rights (including where, at the direction of the official, person performing managerial functions in a commercial or other organisation, foreign official or official of a public international organisation, money, securities or other property are transferred, offered or promised, services of a property nature are provided or property rights are granted to another individual or legal entity) in return for the performance by that official, person performing managerial functions in a commercial or other organisation, foreign official or official of a public international organisation, in the interests of that legal entity or a legal entity associated with it, of an action (inaction) connected with their official position —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 19.28

units.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity
units.text: entails the imposition on legal entities of an administrative fine of up to three times the amount of money or value of securities, other property, services of a property nature or other property rights unlawfully transferred or provided, or promised or offered, on behalf of the legal entity, but not less than one million roubles, with confiscation of the money, securities or other property or the value of the services of a property nature or other property rights.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 19.28 · “entails the imposition on legal entities of an administrative…”

units.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity
units.text: 2. The actions provided for by part 1 of this Article, committed on a large scale —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 19.28

units.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity
units.text: entail the imposition on legal entities of an administrative fine of up to thirty times the amount of money or value of securities, other property, services of a property nature or other property rights unlawfully transferred or provided, or promised or offered, on behalf of the legal entity, but not less than twenty million roubles, with confiscation of the money, securities or other property or the value of the services of a property nature or other property rights.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 19.28 · “entail the imposition on legal entities of an administrative…”

units.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity
units.text: 3. The actions provided for by part 1 of this Article, committed on an especially large scale —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 19.28

units.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity
units.text: entail the imposition on legal entities of an administrative fine of up to one hundred times the amount of money or value of securities, other property, services of a property nature or other property rights unlawfully transferred or provided, or promised or offered, on behalf of the legal entity, but not less than one hundred million roubles, with confiscation of the money, securities or other property or the value of the services of a property nature or other property rights.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 19.28 · “entail the imposition on legal entities of an administrative…”

units.text: Notes:

units.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity
units.text: 1. In this Article, an official means the persons specified in notes 1 - 3 to Article 285 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Art. 19.28 · “1. In this Article, an official means the persons specified in…”

units.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity
units.text: 2. In this Article, a person performing managerial functions in a commercial or other organisation means a person specified in note 1 to Article 201 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Art. 19.28 · “2. In this Article, a person performing managerial functions in…”

units.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity
units.text: 3. In this Article, a foreign official means any appointed or elected person holding any office in a legislative, executive, administrative or judicial body of a foreign state and any person performing any public function for a foreign state, including for a public agency or public enterprise; an official of a public international organisation means an international civil servant or any person authorised by such an organisation to act on its behalf.
units.label: Art. 19.28 · “3. In this Article, a foreign official means any appointed or…”

units.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity
units.text: 4. In this Article, a large scale means an amount of money or value of securities, other property, services of a property nature or other property rights exceeding one million roubles; an especially large scale means an amount or value exceeding twenty million roubles.
units.label: Art. 19.28 · “4. In this Article, a large scale means an amount of money or…”

units.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity
units.text: 5. A legal entity shall be exempt from administrative liability for the administrative offence provided for by this Article if it assisted in the detection of that offence, the conduct of an administrative investigation and (or) the detection, solving and investigation of a crime connected with that offence, or if extortion took place against that legal entity.
units.label: Art. 19.28 · “5. A legal entity shall be exempt from administrative liability…”

units.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity
units.text: 6. The provision set out in note 5 to this Article shall not apply to administrative offences committed in relation to foreign officials and officials of public international organisations in the conduct of commercial transactions.
units.label: Art. 19.28 · “6. The provision set out in note 5 to this Article shall not…”

units.locator: Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process
units.text: 1. Violation of the requirements for conducting educational activities established by education legislation, manifested in the conduct of educational activities by representative offices of educational organisations or violation of the rules for providing paid educational services —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 19.30

units.locator: Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process
units.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 19.30 · “entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials…”

units.locator: Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process
units.text: 2. Failure to implement educational programmes in full in accordance with the curriculum, or unlawful refusal to issue documents on education and (or) qualifications —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 19.30

units.locator: Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process
units.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 19.30 · “entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials…”

units.locator: Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process
units.text: 3. Issuance by an organisation conducting educational activities, in respect of educational programmes without state accreditation, of documents on education or documents on education and qualifications in the form established under education legislation —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 19.30

units.locator: Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process
units.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for six months to one year; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 19.30 · “entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials…”

units.locator: Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process
units.text: 4. Intentional distortion of the results of state final assessment and school pupil olympiads provided for by education legislation, as well as violation of the procedure for conducting state final assessment established by education legislation —
units.label: Part 4 Art. 19.30

units.locator: Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process
units.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 19.30 · “entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of…”

units.locator: Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process
units.text: 5. Violation of the procedure for admission to an educational organisation established by education legislation —
units.label: Part 5 Art. 19.30

units.locator: Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process
units.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 19.30 · “entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials…”

units.locator: Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process
units.text: 6. Commission of an administrative offence provided for by part 3 or 4 of this Article by an official previously subjected to an administrative penalty for a similar administrative offence —
